title: AION 2 Twitch Drops: Campaigns and Rewards
description: See the Advanced Access and Global launch Twitch Drops, viewing milestones, correct Steam or PURPLE linking, and missing-reward checks.
summary: Compare both Global Drops campaigns, claim each reward, and connect the account that contains your character.
quickAnswer: Link your Global game identity to Twitch, watch a participating channel and claim each completed Drop in Twitch inventory. Standard Drops run September 30–October 4 and October 5–16; War For Atreia is a separate creator campaign with its own channel and unlock conditions.

workflow.title: Get Drops to the account you play
workflow.caption: Confirm the linked playing identity before claiming a reward.

steps.label: Choose the playing identity
steps.description: Steam players use Steam; PURPLE players use their NC account.

steps.label: Inspect the connection
steps.description: Open My Page → Manage Login and check that the linked Steam or NC account contains your character.

steps.label: Watch and track progress
steps.description: Watch a participating channel for the relevant campaign and check its progress in Twitch inventory.

steps.label: Claim and check delivery
steps.description: Claim the earned Drop in Twitch inventory, then check the game account. Follow support guidance if it is missing.
